titleEn: Number of Visible People in a Queue
title: 队列中可以看到的人数
summary: 队列中每人向右看，若两人之间所有人都矮于两者中的较矮者则可见，求每人可见人数。
insight: 从右向左维护递减栈。当前人能看到并弹出所有比自己矮的人；弹完后若栈非空，还能看到第一个比自己高的人。
pitfalls: 被弹出的矮人各计一个
首个更高者可见但不能弹出

solutions.title: 递减身高栈
solutions.idea: 把被遮挡者在确定其左侧可见关系后弹出。
steps: 若栈非空 answer++；压入当前身高

code.java: class Solution { public int[] canSeePersonsCount(int[] heights){int[] answer=new int[heights.length];Deque<Integer> stack=new ArrayDeque<>();for(int i=heights.length-1;i>=0;i--){while(!stack.isEmpty()&&stack.peek()<heights[i]){stack.pop();answer[i]++;}if(!stack.isEmpty())answer[i]++;stack.push(heights[i]);}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun canSeePersonsCount(heights:IntArray):IntArray{val answer=IntArray(heights.size);val stack=java.util.ArrayDeque<Int>();for(i in heights.lastIndex downTo 0){while(stack.isNotEmpty()&&stack.peek()<heights[i]){stack.pop();answer[i]++};if(stack.isNotEmpty())answer[i]++;stack.push(heights[i])};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: vector<int> canSeePersonsCount(vector<int>& heights){vector<int> answer(heights.size()),stack;for(int i=heights.size()-1;i>=0;--i){while(!stack.empty()&&stack.back()<heights[i]){stack.pop_back();++answer[i];}if(!stack.empty())++answer[i];stack.push_back(heights[i]);}return answer;} };
